## ЛР3: микробенчмарк — Jackson 3 vs kotlinx.serialization

Сравниваются **две библиотеки JSON** на одной задаче:
- **Jackson 3** (синий) — runtime-рефлексия, production vidayapi;
- **kotlinx.serialization** (зелёный) — сериализация на этапе компиляции.

**Модель** (переключатель сверху): **x1** 10 полей / **x4** 40 / **x8** 80.
Сценарии: **read** (JSON→объект), **write** (объект→JSON), **mixed** (чтение+запись).
Методика: warmup → settle → measure → teardown, batch=256, 1 ядро CPU.

На каждом графике **обе библиотеки наложены** (как SVG overlay в report.html):
- **Временной ряд** — X: номер сэмпла, Y: нс/операция. Горизонтальные асимптоты — перцентили каждой библиотеки.
- **CDF** — X: латентность нс/оп, Y: доля запросов. Чем левее кривая — тем быстрее. Вертикальные асимптоты — те же перцентили.
- **Гистограмма** — общие бины по диапазону обеих серий, столбцы рядом.
- **Перцентили** — мультивыбор **percentile**. На latency/CDF **p50 и p95 всегда**; p75/p90/p99 — если добавить сверху. Столбцы сравнивают выбранные значения.

panels.title: ${percentile}: ns/операция — Jackson 3 vs kotlinx.serialization (3 модели × 3 сценария)

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(both FROM x) AS p
  FROM unnest(string_to_array('${percentile:csv}', ',')) AS t(x)
  WHERE trim(both FROM x) <> ''
)
SELECT t.model || '·' || t.direction
         || CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM selected) > 1 THEN '·' || t.p ELSE '' END AS scenario,
       MAX(t.pct) FILTER (WHERE t.library = 'jackson') AS jackson,
       MAX(t.pct) FILTER (WHERE t.library = 'kotlinx') AS kotlinx
FROM (
  SELECT c.model, c.direction, c.library, s.p,
         CASE s.p
           WHEN 'p50' THEN c.p50_ns
           WHEN 'p75' THEN c.p75_ns
           WHEN 'p90' THEN c.p90_ns
           WHEN 'p95' THEN c.p95_ns
           WHEN 'p99' THEN c.p99_ns
         END AS pct
  FROM benchmark_cases c
  CROSS JOIN selected s
  WHERE c.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1)
) t
GROUP BY t.model, t.direction, t.p
ORDER BY t.model,
         CASE t.direction WHEN 'read' THEN 1 WHEN 'write' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         CASE t.p WHEN 'p50' THEN 1 WHEN 'p75' THEN 2 WHEN 'p90' THEN 3 WHEN 'p95' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

read: Jackson vs kotlinx — временной ряд

targets.rawSql:
WITH wanted_pcts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trim(both FROM x) AS p
  FROM unnest(ARRAY['p50','p95'] || string_to_array('${percentile:csv}', ',')) AS t(x)
  WHERE trim(both FROM x) <> ''
),
lines AS (
  SELECT (MAX(p50_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'jackson')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p50' LIMIT 1) AS jackson_p50,
         (MAX(p50_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'kotlinx')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p50' LIMIT 1) AS kotlinx_p50,
         (MAX(p75_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'jackson')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p75' LIMIT 1) AS jackson_p75,
         (MAX(p75_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'kotlinx')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p75' LIMIT 1) AS kotlinx_p75,
         (MAX(p90_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'jackson')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p90' LIMIT 1) AS jackson_p90,
         (MAX(p90_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'kotlinx')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p90' LIMIT 1) AS kotlinx_p90,
         (MAX(p95_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'jackson')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p95' LIMIT 1) AS jackson_p95,
         (MAX(p95_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'kotlinx')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p95' LIMIT 1) AS kotlinx_p95,
         (MAX(p99_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'jackson')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p99' LIMIT 1) AS jackson_p99,
         (MAX(p99_ns) FILTER (WHERE library = 'kotlinx')) * (SELECT 1 FROM wanted_pcts WHERE p = 'p99' LIMIT 1) AS kotlinx_p99
  FROM benchmark_cases
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1)
    AND direction = 'read'
    AND model = '${model}'
)
SELECT s.sample_index AS sample,
       MAX(s.ns_per_op) FILTER (WHERE s.library = 'jackson') AS jackson,
       MAX(s.ns_per_op) FILTER (WHERE s.library = 'kotlinx') AS kotlinx,
       MAX(l.jackson_p50) AS jackson_p50,
       MAX(l.kotlinx_p50) AS kotlinx_p50,
       MAX(l.jackson_p75) AS jackson_p75,
       MAX(l.kotlinx_p75) AS kotlinx_p75,
       MAX(l.jackson_p90) AS jackson_p90,
       MAX(l.kotlinx_p90) AS kotlinx_p90,
       MAX(l.jackson_p95) AS jackson_p95,
       MAX(l.kotlinx_p95) AS kotlinx_p95,
       MAX(l.jackson_p99) AS jackson_p99,
       MAX(l.kotlinx_p99) AS kotlinx_p99
FROM benchmark_samples s
CROSS JOIN lines l
WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND s.direction = 'read'
  AND s.model = '${model}'
GROUP BY s.sample_index
ORDER BY s.sample_index

    AND direction = 'read'
    AND model = '${model}'
)
SELECT c.latency_ns,
       MAX(c.fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.library = 'jackson') AS jackson,
       MAX(c.fraction) FILTER (WHERE c.library = 'kotlinx') AS kotlinx,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p50,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p50,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p75,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p75,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p90,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p90,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p95,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p95,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p99,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p99
FROM benchmark_cdf c
WHERE c.run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND c.direction = 'read'
  AND c.model = '${model}'
GROUP BY c.latency_ns
UNION ALL
SELECT c.p50_ns + v.dy AS latency_ns,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx,
       CASE WHEN c.library = 'jackson' THEN v.y END AS jackson_p50,
       CASE WHEN c.library = 'kotlinx' THEN v.y END AS kotlinx_p50,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p75,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p75,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p90,

       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p95,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p95,
       NULL::double precision AS jackson_p99,
       NULL::double precision AS kotlinx_p99
FROM cases c
CROSS JOIN (VALUES (0.0, 0.0), (1e-6, 1.0)) AS v(dy, y)

WITH src AS (
  SELECT library, ns_per_op
  FROM benchmark_samples
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM benchmark_runs ORDER BY generated_at DESC LIMIT 1)
    AND direction = 'read'
    AND model = '${model}'
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(ns_per_op) AS lo, max(ns_per_op) AS hi FROM src
),
binned AS (
  SELECT library,
         width_bucket(ns_per_op, (SELECT lo FROM b), (SELECT hi FROM b) + 1e-6, 20) AS bucket
  FROM src
)
SELECT ROUND(((SELECT lo FROM b)
              + (bucket - 0.5) * ((SELECT hi FROM b) - (SELECT lo FROM b)) / 20.0)::numeric, 1) AS latency_ns,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE library = 'jackson') AS jackson,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE library = 'kotlinx') AS kotlinx
FROM binned
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
